review_policy: Conservative mapping for read-only evidence collection. Do not infer NOT_LICENSED unless tenant subscription/service-plan evidence proves absence for the specific capability and no source ambiguity remains.

global_classification_rules.rule: Only emit NOT_LICENSED when subscribedSkus/servicePlans or another retained entitlement artifact proves the required capability is absent. If the SKU mapping is incomplete or ambiguous, emit UNKNOWN with limitation license_limited.
If Graph, PowerShell, or UI collection returns 401, 403, RBAC denial, missing consent, or explicit access-denied, emit NOT_ACCESSIBLE rather than UNKNOWN.
A service plan proves capability only when the parent SKU capabilityStatus is Enabled and the service plan provisioningStatus is not Disabled/Suspended/Deleted.
Tenant subscribed SKU evidence proves tenant availability, not whether a specific user is assigned or enabled for the service. User assignment checks require a separate user-license artifact.

Collectors must compare mapping last_reviewed against the assessment date. If older than mapping_completeness.review_staleness_days_warn, emit WARN/UNKNOWN with limitation stale_mapping rather than overclaiming PASS/FAIL/NOT_LICENSED.

If mapping_completeness.claims_complete_coverage is false for the relevant capability, absence of a known SKU/service plan is not sufficient for NOT_LICENSED. Emit UNKNOWN with limitation license_limited unless another source proves absence.
A conservative fallback match is never PASS evidence. It blocks NOT_LICENSED and should produce WARN or UNKNOWN with limitation stale_mapping/manual_review_required until reviewed.

COPILOT_STUDIO_IN_COPILOT_FOR_M365.displayName: Copilot Studio in Copilot for M365

M365_COPILOT_CONNECTORS.displayName: Power Platform Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot

Microsoft_Copilot_for_Sales.note: Do not treat this SKU alone as full Microsoft 365 Copilot tenant readiness; use service-plan evidence for specific capabilities.

positive_evidence.source: Microsoft Graph /subscribedSkus returns 200 OK with one or more subscribedSku objects or an empty collection for a tenant with no commercial subscriptions.

classification.PASS: At least one known Microsoft 365 Copilot family service plan is present and enabled. This proves Copilot-family entitlement evidence, not full governance readiness.
classification.UNKNOWN: No known service plan is present but mapping may be incomplete or tenant uses a SKU not represented in this map.
classification.NOT_LICENSED: Only allowed when the tenant SKU inventory is complete/readable, the relevant mapping explicitly claims complete coverage as of last_reviewed, no exact or fallback match is found, and customer baseline requires the capability. Otherwise use UNKNOWN with limitation license_limited.

fallback_match_strategy.purpose: Prevent false NOT_LICENSED when Microsoft introduces or renames Copilot SKUs/service plans before this map is updated.
fallback_match_strategy.collector_rule: Fallback matches must be surfaced as possible entitlement evidence, must retain raw sku/servicePlan data, and must not produce PASS or NOT_LICENSED without operator review.

classification.PASS: Graph-grounded work chat service plan is present and enabled.
classification.UNKNOWN: Service plan not detected but mapping or user assignment may be incomplete.
classification.NOT_LICENSED: Allowed only if full tenant inventory proves absence, this capability is in customer baseline, the mapping explicitly claims complete coverage for this exact capability, and no fallback Copilot-family entitlement evidence is present.

LIC-002.microsoft_365_copilot_work_graph.fallback_behavior: If broader Copilot-family entitlement is detected but exact Work Graph chat service plan is not, classify UNKNOWN with limitation license_limited rather than NOT_LICENSED.

classification.PASS: Labels are returned and at least one enabled label exists.
classification.WARN: Labels are returned but no enabled label or minimal taxonomy is present.

positive_evidence.source: Security & Compliance PowerShell Get-DlpCompliancePolicy/Get-DlpComplianceRule returns readable policy and rule objects.

classification.PASS: Policy inventory is readable; Copilot-specific targeting is classified by config/dlp_copilot_location_map.json.
classification.NOT_ACCESSIBLE: PowerShell connection or cmdlet returns explicit role/access/permission denial.
classification.UNKNOWN: PowerShell output is unavailable, malformed, or not sufficient to classify Copilot policy location.

positive_evidence.source: Microsoft documentation states SAM features needed for Copilot deployment are available when the organization has a Copilot license and at least one assigned Copilot user; standalone SAM licensing can also apply.

match_for_copilot_included_sam.requires_role_check: SharePoint Administrator or equivalent must still be proven separately.

standalone_sam_sku_mapping.reason: Official docs confirm standalone SAM licensing exists, but this map does not yet include a verified Graph skuPartNumber/servicePlanId for SharePoint Advanced Management Plan 1.
standalone_sam_sku_mapping.collector_rule: If no Copilot-family entitlement is found and standalone SAM mapping remains unverified, emit UNKNOWN with limitation license_limited; do not emit NOT_LICENSED from this map alone.

classification.PASS: Copilot-family entitlement is present and SharePoint/SAM read check succeeds.
classification.WARN: Entitlement appears present but report freshness/long-running constraints apply.
classification.UNKNOWN: Standalone SAM may be licensed but cannot be identified from this map, role/capability read check has not run, or mapping freshness/completeness is insufficient.
classification.NOT_ACCESSIBLE: SharePoint admin or PowerShell access denied.
classification.NOT_LICENSED: Only if readable entitlement evidence proves neither Copilot-included SAM nor a verified standalone SAM entitlement is present. Because standalone SAM mapping is not verified in this file, absence of Copilot-family plans alone must not produce NOT_LICENSED.

positive_evidence.source: Microsoft Graph Purview Audit Search API query can be created and read.

classification.PASS: Audit query runs to completion for the requested scope.
classification.WARN: Audit query works but retention, latency, bandwidth, or scope limits affect assurance.
classification.NOT_ACCESSIBLE: AuditLogsQuery permission, role, or consent denial.
classification.UNKNOWN: No conclusive result due timeout/transient service behavior.

positive_evidence.source: Retention policy/export/manual artifact proves explicit Copilot/AI app retention stance.

classification.PASS: Explicit stance is evidenced and matches customer baseline.
classification.WARN: No explicit Copilot/AI retention policy is evidenced, or evidence is manual/partial.
classification.FAIL: Only if customer baseline requires explicit policy and readable evidence proves absence or misconfiguration.
classification.NOT_LICENSED: Required retention capability is proven absent.

positive_evidence.source: Purview eDiscovery capability evidence, Graph eDiscovery permission, Purview app-only service-principal/RBAC evidence, or permitted positive search plus export-validating/customer-provided Purview artifact. A no-source search/estimate artifact is an API reachability signal only. A mailbox-location zero-result validation remains WARN/partial evidence.

classification.PASS: Capability plus either permitted positive search with separate export-validating evidence, or customer-provided Purview export/readiness artifact.
classification.WARN: Capability exists but no mailbox/content-bound test/export was run; no-source API validation alone remains WARN/manual-review evidence; mailbox-location zero-result validation remains WARN/partial evidence; positive search count without export-validating evidence remains WARN/partial evidence.
classification.FAIL: Only if baseline requires eDiscovery readiness and readable evidence proves it is unavailable or misconfigured.
classification.NOT_ACCESSIBLE: eDiscovery access denied, including missing/unverified Purview app-only service-principal/RBAC prerequisite even when Graph eDiscovery.Read.All is present.
classification.NOT_LICENSED: Required eDiscovery capability is proven absent.

mapping_completeness.collector_requirement: Collectors must record schema_version and last_reviewed. If last_reviewed is older than review_staleness_days_warn, classify affected checks as WARN or UNKNOWN with limitation stale_mapping unless independently verified during the run.
not_licensed_requires: Tenant SKU inventory is readable and complete for the assessment run.
The relevant capability mapping explicitly claims complete coverage for the required capability as of last_reviewed.
No exact match or conservative fallback match is found.
No access, API, role, or tenant-policy limitation prevents reading entitlement evidence.
